title: 36 Hours in Mumbai, India
abstract: Glamour hub, culinary capital, coastal metropolis: The teeming city of Mumbai has enough sights, glitter and art for everyone.

title: 36 Hours in Asheville, N.C.
abstract: Mountain-ringed and progressively minded, the city that calls itself Land of the Sky is renowned for its creative spirit.

title: 36 Hours in San Sebastián, Spain
abstract: Beyond the beach, this seaside resort’s enticements include art, architecture and, of course, dining on delectable small plates at pintxo bars.

title: 36 Hours in Malta
abstract: Many conquerors and countries have left their mark on this Mediterranean archipelago, and visitors will likely be entranced with the cultural mash-up.
